headline: Malott folds Buckley with a knee in Edmonton, Verstappen charges from 24th to ninth on his GT3 debut, Genesis pinches WEC pole from Toyota, and GTA 6's launch trailer is out a month before release.

upcoming.what: WEC 6 Hours of Barcelona, 11:00–17:00 Irish time. Genesis on pole, title-leading #8 Toyota alongside
ID@Xbox indie showcase, broadcast by IGN
Orionid meteor shower peaks; best after midnight, though moonlight will hide the faint ones
F1 United States GP, Austin (sprint weekend); Irish clocks go back on Sunday 25th

items.headline: Verstappen recovers to ninth after penalty in Portimão GT3 debut
items.summary: A drive-through for Lulham's Turn 8 contact with a Winward Mercedes dropped the #3 Verstappen.com Racing AMG to 24th, but Max's closing stint hauled it back to ninth. GetSpeed's #17 Mercedes (Aron, Götz, Schiller) won the GTWC Europe finale.

items.headline: Genesis takes a maiden WEC pole in Barcelona
items.summary: Mathys Jaubert put the Genesis on pole by 0.17s from Hirakawa's title-leading #8 Toyota, in the team's first season. Both BMWs missed Hyperpole and start 14th and 16th; the six-hour race starts at 11:00 Irish time today.

items.headline: Malott flattens Buckley with a knee in Edmonton
items.summary: Canada's Mike Malott timed a knee and follow-up punch to stop Joaquin Buckley at 2:32 of round two, an instant Knockout of the Year contender in front of a home crowd.

items.headline: Jasudavicius upsets Blanchfield
items.summary: Jasmine Jasudavicius took a clean 29-28 sweep over Erin Blanchfield in the co-main, a big flyweight statement. Elsewhere, Barriault, Perez and Nallo all won inside the distance.

items.headline: Anthropic leases a C$10bn data centre campus in Nova Scotia
items.summary: A 20-year deal with EverWind Fuels gives Anthropic its first Canadian data centre, with the first phase targeted for late 2027.

items.headline: DeepSeek opens V4.1-Flash with built-in web search
items.summary: The MIT-licensed 552B sparse mixture-of-experts model comes with new Search and Fetch APIs for live retrieval.

items.headline: Korean startup DeepX starts mass-producing its NPU
items.summary: The DX-M1 edge AI chip is now in production on Samsung's 5nm process, with a 2nm successor due to tape out this month. One for the industrial-edge crowd.

items.headline: Leak claims Amazon tool scores UK warehouses on union risk
items.summary: openDemocracy says Amazon's Atlas system rates sites including two in the UK by unionisation risk. Amazon says Atlas isn't currently used in the UK.

items.headline: One rule may govern black hole jets of every size
items.summary: Astronomers found that black holes from stellar-mass to supermassive appear to launch their eruptions under the same underlying relationship.

items.headline: Farside samples may explain the Moon's two faces
items.summary: Analysis of rock returned from the lunar farside offers a fresh explanation for why the two hemispheres look so different.

items.headline: Webb finds an ancient cluster with oddly dense dark matter
items.summary: An early galaxy cluster seems to pack more dark matter than models expect for its age. A quieter weekend for launches otherwise; Orionids peak on Wednesday.

items.headline: GTA 6 launch trailer drops ahead of 19 November
items.summary: Rockstar's in-engine PS5 trailer leans into heists, chases and the Keys, set to new Justice music, though it reveals little new.

items.headline: CDPR says Project Hadar is its biggest undertaking yet
items.summary: Alongside The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2, the studio says its new IP's world is now built. No new Witcher 4 or Orion dates this week.

items.headline: A quiet open-circuit weekend
items.summary: Fight to Win 328 ran Friday and ADCC opens in New Jersey and Peru filled Saturday, but no major headline results. The Crown on 8 November is the next big one.
